notes.main_session: The main session starts on Opus (Flight Control's .claude/settings.json). /model or a model line in .claude/settings.local.json overrules it; never Haiku.
notes.roles: Each role is a model string or {"model": "...", "effort": "low|medium|high|max"}. Change one with sh bin/afc agents set <role> <model>; agents sync rewrites the agent files.
notes.providers: opus, sonnet and haiku mean the newest version on the Anthropic API. On Bedrock or Vertex an alias may be older: pin full model IDs under roles, e.g. {"build": {"model": "anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-20250514-v1:0"}}
notes.tools: Optional. Per AI tool (cursor, codex, copilot, antigravity): {"model": "...", "seen": "..."} from sh bin/afc model choose. Flight Control never writes the tool's own settings.
